description: This file implements the login page for a web application using Remix and React. It includes server-side logic for loading (redirecting logged-in users away from login page) and handling login submissions, as well as client-side UI rendering for the login form and handling validation/error display.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that redirects logged-in users away from the login page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Action function that handles login form submissions, invoking the login utility.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React component rendering the login form UI and managing form state.
